posts.description: The Rails dev container images can lag behind Ruby releases. Here's how to build on the Docker Hub ruby image instead.

posts.title: Running Migrations Once During a Multi-Host Kamal Deploy

posts.title: Using UUIDv7 with Rails without PostgreSQL 18
posts.description: UUIDv7 was added to PostgreSQL 18 to support time-based UUIDs, but you don't have to upgrade to take advantage of them now.
